SCIFI HANGAR for Blender 3,5
This sci-fi hangar has been created using Blender and incorporates materials for detailing; thus, it does not contain textures. The images are renders produced in Blender using the Cycles engine, so it's important to consider this when purchasing the product. The hangar is available in FBX and OBJ formats but may not be suitable for game engines. Nonetheless, it's perfect for crafting short sci-fi scenes in Blender. The outlines have been meticulously detailed.
OBJECTS- 328 FACES -3,137,000 Triangles- 5,382,000
Step into the realm of futuristic possibilities with this meticulously crafted sci-fi hangar, meticulously designed using Blender. Immerse yourself in the intricacies of its details, each element thoughtfully sculpted to evoke a sense of otherworldly wonder.
Rendered using the powerful Cycles engine, the hangar comes to life in stunning clarity and realism. While it lacks textures, its use of materials for detailing adds depth and dimension to every corner.
Available in FBX and OBJ formats, this hangar may not be optimized for game engines, but it serves as the perfect canvas for constructing captivating sci-fi scenes within Blender. Let your creativity soar as you explore the endless potential of this immersive environment.
